Parasect

Bug Grass

Kanto · Generation 1

Parasect is a Bug/Grass-type Mushroom Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 29.5 kg. It evolves from Paras. Its highest base stat is Attack (95), with a base stat total of 405.
